llm_response.reason: The website presents itself as a courier/shipping notification site despite being hosted on an unrelated domain (aboutdoghealth.info), uses psychological urgency ('Shipment confirmed!', 'Searching...'), displays unusually low prices ('Massive Discount', 'Shipping Cost R 65'), lacks any real company/business details, and solicits user information under false pretenses. This matches multiple scam characteristics: spoofing a legitimate service, targeting user psychological weaknesses, ambiguous company info, and urgency tactics.
